title: Gold’s 30-Year Perfect Storm: How Does It End? | Brad Langille
speaker: Brad Langille (CEO, GoGold Resources), interviewed by David Lin

macro_themes.view: A decade of under-investment in exploration and long permitting/build times mean mine supply has probably peaked for the next ~5 years.
Debasement is real and central banks are buying gold for that reason.
Best setup for metal prices he has seen in his career; potentially the start of a strong bull market.
Mexican mining capex/opex inflation runs 8-10%, but commodity prices are rising much faster than costs.
Under President Sheinbaum permits are moving faster and the industry is 'full steam ahead'.

calls.reason: Fully funded Los Ricos South build from ~$284M cash with no debt, Parral generating $50-70M/yr; Los Ricos North+South targeted at $425-475M annual after-tax FCF; trades ~0.5x NAV vs 1.7-2x NAV silver takeouts.
calls.quote: we're probably trading at around a 0.5 of a NAV

calls.reason: Under-investment in supply, debasement and central-bank buying; he calls it the best metals setup of his career.
calls.quote: I think we're potentially at the start of a strong bull market in the metal price

calls.reason: Peak gold supply this cycle, currency debasement and central-bank buying.
calls.quote: in my career, I don't think I've ever seen a better setup for the metal price than right now
